svg.title: Gargoyle Roofwalk — Gargoyle eaves
svg.desc: Staggered roof ridges and chimney tops form the encounter loop. Drainpipe ladders and maintenance ropes create sheltered retreats below the exposed gargoyle perches. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Staggered roof ridges and chimney tops form the encounter loop. Drainpipe ladders and
maintenance ropes create sheltered retreats below the exposed gargoyle perches.
8 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 3 ladders · 26 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Hillkeep Gargoyle · Corrupted / Common; optional local encounter.
